Excellent! I now have enough information from all searches to compile a thorough digest. Here is the full curated list of in-person Brisbane events for the week of **11–17 May 2026**:

# 🗓️ Brisbane Events Digest: 11–17 May 2026

---

## 🎨 ARTS / EXHIBITION

---

### 1. 🖼️ Platform 2026 — Ongoing Exhibition @ IMA
**Institute of Modern Art, Fortitude Valley**

The IMA's annual Platform exhibition spotlights Queensland emerging artists. This year it presents new works by Dean Ansell — a multidisciplinary artist of Melanesian descent whose installations, soundscapes, and performances interpret Melanesian mythologies and rituals — Spencer Harvie, a Brisbane-born painter who explores dark, surreal aspects of online and fan subcultures, blending found, AI-generated, and imagined imagery within an elaborate cartoon logic, and Seren Wagstaff, who works in installation and performance, exploring working-class cultures and queer innuendo.

- 📅 Tues–Sun, 10am–5pm (throughout the week)
- 📍 Ground Floor, Judith Wright Arts Centre, 420 Brunswick St, Fortitude Valley
- 💰 **Free**
- 🔗 https://www.ima.org.au/exhibitions/platform-2026/
- 🏷️ **Arts / Exhibition**

---

### 2. 🎤 Platform 2026 Artist Talks @ IMA
**Institute of Modern Art, Fortitude Valley**

Free artist talks at IMA's Ground Floor Gallery, where Dean Ansell, Spencer Harvie, and Seren Wagstaff speak about their newly commissioned works in this annual Queensland-emerging-artist exhibition. Each year three artists are funded to create ambitious new projects.

> ⚠️ **Note:** The IMA website confirms this event is happening during the Platform 2026 exhibition period, but the exact talk date is not shown on the event page — register via the IMA to confirm. It may fall this week.

- 📅 During exhibition run (check IMA website)
- 📍 IMA, 420 Brunswick St, Fortitude Valley
- 💰 **Free** (register online)
- 🔗 https://www.ima.org.au/ima-events/platform-2026-artist-talks/
- 🏷️ **Public Lecture / Arts**

---

### 3. 🎵 Free Range 6: SCRAPS (Laura Hill) @ IMA
**Institute of Modern Art, Fortitude Valley**

IMA's Thursday night sound club, **Free Range**, returns with SCRAPS — Brisbane underground veteran Laura Hill's analogue synth-pop project, inhabiting a hazy space between club beats and keyboard pop. She's been dropping arpeggiated analogue bliss-bombs for over 20 years. A local treasure and live favourite. Pay What You Can entry.

> ⚠️ **Note:** The IMA music events page lists this event; confirm the specific Thursday date via their event page.

- 📅 Thursday evening (likely **Thu 14 May**, check IMA website)
- 📍 IMA Ground Floor Gallery, 420 Brunswick St, Fortitude Valley
- 💰 **Pay What You Can**
- 🔗 https://www.ima.org.au/ima-events/free-range-6/
- 🏷️ **Concert / Music**

## 🎶 CONCERT / MUSIC

---

### 4. 🎶 Mariah the Scientist: Hearts Sold Separately @ Fortitude Music Hall
**Fortitude Valley**

Mariah the Scientist performs at The Fortitude Music Hall on **Tuesday 12 May 2026 at 7:00 PM**. Tickets from ~$89 via resale platforms. Atlanta R&B/neo-soul artist Mariah the Scientist brings her atmospheric, emotionally intense sound to Brisbane on the *Hearts Sold Separately* tour.

- 📅 **Tue 12 May, 7:00pm**
- 📍 The Fortitude Music Hall, 312–318 Brunswick St, Fortitude Valley
- 💰 From ~$89
- 🔗 https://www.thefortitude.com.au/all-events/
- 🏷️ **Concert / Music**

### 5. 🎤 Jason Leong: In Laughing Memory @ Fortitude Music Hall
**Fortitude Valley**

Jason Leong: In Laughing Memory performs at The Fortitude Music Hall on **Thursday 14 May 2026 at 7:30 PM**. Malaysian stand-up comedian Jason Leong brings his sharp, observational humour to Brisbane in an intimate touring comedy show.

- 📅 **Thu 14 May, 7:30pm**
- 📍 The Fortitude Music Hall, 312–318 Brunswick St, Fortitude Valley
- 💰 Ticketed (check Ticketmaster)
- 🔗 https://www.thefortitude.com.au/all-events/
- 🏷️ **Concert / Music / Comedy**

### 6. 🎶 J.I.D — God Does Like World Tour @ Fortitude Music Hall
**Fortitude Valley**

J.I.D — God Does Like World Tours (relocated from Riverstage) performs at The Fortitude Music Hall on **Friday 15 May 2026 at 7:00 PM**. Tickets from ~$60. Atlanta rapper J.I.D, one of hip-hop's most compelling live performers, brings his *Luv Is 4Ever* era world tour to a more intimate indoor venue after the Riverstage date was relocated.

- 📅 **Fri 15 May, 7:00pm**
- 📍 The Fortitude Music Hall, 312–318 Brunswick St, Fortitude Valley
- 💰 From ~$60
- 🔗 https://www.thefortitude.com.au/all-events/

**Fortitude Valley**

Audrey Hobert performs The Staircase To Stardom Tour at The Fortitude Music Hall on **Saturday 16 May 2026 at 7:00 PM**. Rising indie-pop singer-songwriter Audrey Hobert brings her cinematic, emotionally rich songwriting to Brisbane for what promises to be an atmospheric, intimate gig.

- 📍 The Fortitude Music Hall, 312–318 Brunswick St, Fortitude Valley

### 8. 🎶 Genesis Owusu @ Fortitude Music Hall
**Fortitude Valley**

Genesis Owusu performs at The Fortitude Music Hall, Brisbane on **Sunday 17 May 2026 at 7:00 PM**. Tickets from ~$111.97. Ghanaian-Australian alt-soul and punk-funk artist Genesis Owusu is one of Australia's most electrifying live performers — expect an intense, genre-defying show full of energy and artistic ambition.

- 📅 **Sun 17 May, 7:00pm**
- 📍 The Fortitude Music Hall, 312–318 Brunswick St, Fortitude Valley

**Fortitude Valley**

Georgia Scarlett performs at The Fortitude Music Hall on **Sunday 17 May 2026**. Brisbane-based Georgia Scarlett is a captivating singer-songwriter known for her folk-pop sound and deeply personal songwriting. A great local act worth catching.

- 📅 **Sun 17 May** (check time via venue)

### 10. 🎶 Quadeca @ The Triffid
**Newstead**

American singer, songwriter, rapper, and producer Quadeca will make his headline debut in Australia in May 2026, in support of his fourth and most ambitious record to date, *Vanisher, Horizon Scraper*. This is an intimate headline debut at The Triffid — check the exact date on the venue website as it falls in May 2026.

### 11. 🎸 Black Bear Lodge — Live Music Program
**Fortitude Valley**

Black Bear Lodge is known for getting first dibs on live EP sets and intimate touring gigs in the heart of Fortitude Valley. Their trivia nights, old-school dance parties, and '90s-flavour DJ sets are a favourite with musos. Sunday Service on Sundays features Queensland's best emerging acts — entry is free. Their 2026 schedule features performances from artists like Headwreck, Will Baker, and Beks.

- 📅 Throughout the week, including **Sun 17 May** (Sunday Service, free)
- 📍 Black Bear Lodge, Fortitude Valley
- 💰 **Free** (Sunday Service) / varies
- 🔗 https://blackbearlodge.bar/events
- 🏷️ **Concert / Music**

## 🛠️ WORKSHOP / CLASS

### 12. 🧺 Weaving is Healing Brisbane
**Mt Coot-tha Botanic Gardens**

A Figure-8 coil weave workshop with roots in Africa and Europe, held **Saturday 16 May 2026** at Mt Coot-tha Botanic Gardens. Participants weave a small basket in a ceremony-style immersive sharing and healing circle. A deeply hands-on, community-oriented creative workshop in a beautiful outdoor setting.

- 📅 **Sat 16 May, 10:30am–3:30pm**
- 📍 Mt Coot-tha Botanic Gardens, Brisbane
- 💰 Ticketed via Eventbrite
- 🔗 https://www.eventbrite.com.au/e/weaving-is-healing-brisbane-may-2026-tickets-1984547702601
- 🏷️ **Workshop / Class**

---

### 13. 🛠️ Brisbane Makerspace — Monday Open Night
**Brisbane Makerspace (Fortitude Valley area)**

Brisbane Makerspace is open to the public every Monday 6–8pm. They facilitate regular events to help members make new friends and social connections — including open nights, working bees, social games nights, and workshops. No membership required to attend public meetups and events. Tools include laser cutting, 3D printing, electronics, and arts & crafts.

- 📅 **Mon 11 May, 6:00–8:00pm**
- 📍 Brisbane Makerspace (check address on their site)
- 💰 **Free** to attend
- 🔗 https://brisbanemaker.space/events/
- 🏷️ **Workshop / Community**

## 🎬 ARTS / FILM

### 14. 🎬 HSBC German Film Festival @ Palace Cinemas Brisbane
**Barracks Cinema & James Street, Brisbane**

This May, the 2026 HSBC German Film Festival presented by Palace, in association with German Films, showcases the best contemporary German cinema direct from major festivals in Europe, plus a selection from German-speaking neighbours Austria and Switzerland. Palace Cinemas specialises in high-quality international and local art-house films, cinema retrospectives, and events. An ideal week to catch subtitled, conversation-starting European cinema.

- 📅 **Throughout the week, 11–17 May**
- 📍 Palace Barracks (Petrie Terrace) & Palace Centro (James St, New Farm)
- 💰 Standard cinema pricing (~$22–$26)
- 🔗 https://www.palacecinemas.com.au/events
- 🏷️ **Arts / Film**

---

### 15. 🎬 Brisbane International Film Festival (BIFF) — Screening Program
**New Farm Cinemas, Palace Barracks & Dendy Venues, Brisbane**

BIFF screenings include Queensland premieres with post-screening Q&As at multiple Brisbane venues including New Farm Cinemas and Palace Barracks, featuring directors and filmmakers in conversation. BIFF typically runs across mid-May — check their schedule for Q&A screenings this week, which are ideal for intellectually engaged film lovers.

- 📅 **Throughout the week (verify exact dates)**
- 📍 New Farm Cinemas, Palace Barracks, Angelika Cinemas, Dendy Coorparoo
- 💰 Varies by session
- 🔗 https://biff.com.au/films-event-schedule/
- 🏷️ **Arts / Film**

## 🌿 WORKSHOP / COMMUNITY

### 16. 🌿 Avid Reader Bookshop — Book Clubs & Author Events (West End)
**West End**

Between hosting author talks, signings, and running a café, Avid Reader hosts a menagerie of book clubs including 'Young and Restless', 'Bloody Crime', Australian, and open book clubs. The Open Book Club (recommended for newcomers) meets on the first Wednesday evening and Thursday morning of each month — meaning this week's sessions (Wed 13 or Thu 14 May) are very likely on.

- 📅 **Wed 13 May (eve) and/or Thu 14 May (morning)** — check avidreader.com.au
- 📍 Avid Reader, 193 Boundary St, West End
- 💰 Free / low cost
- 🔗 https://www.avidreader.com.au/events
- 🏷️ **Social / Community**

### 17. 🎶 Brisbane Language Exchange — Weekly Social
**Brisbane City**

Brisbane Language Exchange — Make Friends, Learn Languages & Culture — is a regular weekly recurring event in Brisbane. A welcoming, casual gathering for people who want to practice foreign languages and meet curious, internationally-minded locals. Events run weekly on Fridays.

- 📅 **Fri 15 May** (recurring weekly)
- 📍 Brisbane City (check Eventbrite for venue)
- 💰 Free / low cost
- 🔗 https://www.eventbrite.com.au/d/australia/brisbane/
- 🏷️ **Social / Meetup**

---

### 18. 🐾 Dog Lovers Festival Brisbane 2026 *(Community pick — outdoor/social)*
**Brisbane Showgrounds, Bowen Hills**

The Dog Lovers Festival runs Saturday 16 and Sunday 17 May 2026, 9am–5pm, at the Brisbane Showgrounds. Queensland's biggest celebration of dogs returns, welcoming proud dog parents, prospective owners, and everyone who just loves being around happy, wagging tails. A family-friendly outdoor community event with hundreds of dogs, breed showcases, and adoption zones — an unexpectedly social, warm, and joyful environment.

- 📅 **Sat 16 – Sun 17 May, 9am–5pm**
- 📍 Brisbane Showgrounds, Bowen Hills
- 💰 Ticketed (check Eventbrite)
- 🔗 https://www.eventbrite.com.au/e/dog-lovers-festival-brisbane-2026-tickets-1236807668029
- 🏷️ **Community / Other**
